propositions: git fetch origin tickets call in dc_store_copy_repo uses capture_output=True with check=True, causing git's stderr to be discarded and CalledProcessError to report only exit status
A single un-retried network call on the critical path of a 41-minute live job causes transient failures to error the entire cell
New run_git helper must capture stderr and raise RuntimeError containing the command, exit status, and git's verbatim stderr message instead of relying on CalledProcessError
fetch_tickets function must retry the network call a bounded number of times with backoff before failing, using retry-then-fail policy to preserve real misconfigurations as red lane failures
All three call sites (fetch, archive, ls-tree) must route through the diagnostic helper to eliminate the capture_output+check=True anti-pattern
